basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old gamer and coffee enthusiast living in the heart of London. When I'm not working as a freelance graphic designer, I love diving into video games like Animal Crossing and Fall Guys. I share a flat with my adorable cat, Luna, and enjoy candle-making as a relaxing hobby. I usually browse Reddit late at night after work or during weekends. Currently single, I'm passionate about connecting with people through shared interests online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in graphic design and have been working in the field for over three years. I keep up with the latest design trends through online courses and forums. My interest in video games and coffee drives me to learn about emerging trends and innovations. Most of my gaming knowledge comes from years of playing and following gaming communities.
